purpose: Opt-in local learning with a human-reviewed path for developer-contributed, cross-host generalizable improvements. No automatic federation or gameplay authority.

entrypoints.two_cohort_research: python -m scripts.community_candidate benchmark --candidate SELECTED_CANDIDATE.json --holdout-a INDEPENDENT_REVIEWED_A.json --holdout-b INDEPENDENT_REVIEWED_B.json

contribution_boundary.allowed_file_type: JSON data only; never pickle, Python, DLL, ONNX operators, bytecode or self-updating scripts

validation_ladder.gate: operator opted-in training under existing context/profile isolation
separate explicit share-weights consent; tensor-only redacted JSON file
schema exact, bounded finite tensors, digest, input dimensions and no executable content
two disjointly supplied holdout cohort files, min 8 vectors each, independently verified dataset provenance not established by CLI
manual developer candidacy, provenance/privacy/license/malware/model poisoning review; independent host datasets and adversarial negative evals
reproduce on multiple physically distinct approved hosts and game builds; compare original shipped model and negative cohorts; rollback/compatibility checks
maintainer-controlled signed reviewed integration and regression suite; never automatic local import

empirical_acceptance_hypotheses.baseline: Existing approved model and simple uniform baseline; require no meaningful degradation on each protected cohort
empirical_acceptance_hypotheses.note: Thresholds other than schema-only 0.01 reconstruction improvement are review proposals and NOT enforced as real gameplay certification.
